query: Add a new button label 'Export CSV' to the transactions page. It needs to show up in both English and Dutch.
expected_behavior: Adds the new key to i18n/source/ (not directly to apps/frontend/src/locales/, which is generated)
Runs bun run generate-locales so the key reaches apps/frontend/src/locales/
Runs bun run sync-nl so the Dutch side gets the new key rather than silently drifting
Finishes with bun run validate-locales and treats a failure there as a broken build, not a warning to ignore
